observations.body: Gathering, rebellion, and the remembered warning. Now, brothers, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

payload.posture: Read 2 Thessalonians 2:1–5 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states gathering, rebellion, and the remembered warning. Now, brothers, about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things? It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
